mechanism: Betamethasone may increase pregabalin levels through potential CYP3A4 inhibition and additive CNS depression risk; pregabalin can potentiate immunosuppressive effects of corticosteroids.
action: Monitor for increased pregabalin side effects (dizziness, somnolence, peripheral edema); counsel on CNS depressant effects; assess need for pregabalin dose adjustment if betamethasone dose is substantial.
